item.title: Loads of potential! C. 1914. One acre in North Carolina. $179,900
item.description: This house has loads of potential! It just had another price reduction! The house was built in 1914. It is located on 1.06 acres in Bethel, North Carolina. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, nice staircase, stained glass window, wainscoting, chair rails, crown moulding, pocket doors and pretty mantels. There is a detached garage on the property. Five bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,500 square feet. $179,900 Contact Kevin Lee with Lee and Harrell Real Estate Professionals: 252

item.title: Deal of the Day! Over 5,000 sf in Pennsylvania. Has a guest apartment! $199,000
item.description: This deal of the day is a big house! There is a guest apartment over the garage! The house was built in 1910. It is located on .61 acre in Johnstown, Pennsylvania. The house features pretty stonework, front porch, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding, built-in seating, large fireplaces, chair rails, wainscoting, leaded glass and an updated kitchen. There is a detached carriage house with a guest apartment above. Six bedrooms, five bathrooms and 5,116 square feet. $199,000 Contact Renee Lizamb

item.title: Pretty stonework! Circa 1936 in North Carolina. $350,000
item.description: This house has pretty stonework! Beautiful area of North Carolina. Within walking distance to Lake Osceola. The house was built in 1936. It is located on .52 acre in Hendersonville, North Carolina. The house features a large patio, big stone fireplace, knotty pine, wood floors, built-in corner cabinets, built-in window sea and baseboards. There is a detached garage on the property. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 946 square feet. $350,000 Contact Phillip Trees with George Real Estate Group: phill

item.title: Has a guesthouse! Over two acres in Virginia. $294,000
item.description: There is a guesthouse on this property! Love the big old trees! The house was built in 1889. It is located on 2.25 acres in Drakes Branch, Virginia. The house features double front doors, original wood floors, baseboards, built-in corner cabinet, crystal chandelier, spacious kitchen and original mantels. The guesthouse is roughly 400 square feet. There is a large back deck, carport and a spacious yard. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,850 square feet. $294,000 Contact Daniel Keeton with Kee
